propositions: Task and story both direct children of epic E cannot hold a direct dependency; T depends_on S gets promoted to E depends_on S (epic blocked by its own child) rather than recording the requested T-to-S edge

Blocking link comparability currently keys on type tier (epic=2, story=1, task/bug=0) instead of structural parent hierarchy; cross-subtree dependencies should escalate to nearest common ancestor's children
The redundancy guard is evaluated on the original source/target before promotion, missing ancestor-descendant pairs that emerge only after promotion

Replace type-tier promotion with NCA-based structural resolution using ancestor chains terminated by a virtual root sentinel, then recompute is_redundant from the resolved pair as an ancestor-descendant test
Non-blocking relations (relates_to, duplicates, supersedes) must retain original-pair is_redundant and gain no new rejections, so the widened predicate applies only to blocking links
_get_ancestors is capped at max_hops=2 and has no cycle guard, causing truncation to chain-root fallback and undefined behavior on malformed parent cycles
